label: Website
note: Marketing sites and landing pages. The heading font does the selling and the colors set the mood.

label: App
note: Phone screens. The font used for labels matters as much as the heading font, and the colors stay calmer.

label: Dashboard
note: Dashboards and admin panels. Busy screens, so easy reading comes first.

label: Article
note: Articles and long reads. Comfortable line length and spacing on a paper-like background.

label: Docs
note: Documentation. Text and code sit side by side, and borders and notes give the page its structure.
